data.title: Nepal seeks climate justice after Himalayan disaster
data.description: KATHMANDU - When a wall of icy debris from a glacial collapse on the China-Nepal border tore through his village last week, Pemba Chhring Tamang watched the landscape he had known all his life disappear.

data.title: Defence chiefs back bigger US military presence in Australia
data.description: SYDNEY - Washington and Canberra have agreed to boost the US military presence in Australia and speed up cooperation, both countries said on Thursday.

data.title: Thailand’s ‘Jurassic Park’ shines light on dinosaur evolution
data.description: KHON KAEN - A dinosaur statue stands guard outside a temple, a hint at the ancient giants buried deep in the earth below making up northeastern Thailand’s “dinosaur rush”.

data.title: ONE Championship: Stamp Fairtex plans MMA return after Selina Flores – but wants ‘one or two’ fights before title shot
data.description: Stamp Fairtex plans to return to MMA after Saturday’s ONE Fight Night 47 main event against Selina Flores – but does not expect to challenge immediately for the promotion’s vacant atomweight title.

data.title: Hamilton aiming for record sixth Italian GP triumph
data.description: MONZA, Monza - Lewis Hamilton will seek to boost his hopes of an unprecedented eighth drivers’ world championship with a record sixth Italian Grand Prix win on Sunday when he races on Ferrari’s home tarmac.

data.title: US not ‘stealing Venezuelan oil’, energy secretary insists
data.description: CARACAS - US Energy Secretary Chris Wright on Wednesday dismissed claims that Washington was “stealing Venezuelan oil” after the South American nation granted its northern neighbour access to a huge chunk of its natural resources.

data.title: Pacific states debate response to Chinese missile test
data.description: KOROR, Palau - The president of Palau called on Thursday for a “unified” Pacific response to July’s missile test by China on the final day of a summit clouded by allegations of meddling by Beijing.

data.title: Guru's daily horoscope for Sept 3
data.description: The day of the week you were born on can reveal a lot... Read on.

data.title: George Lucas unveils art galaxy at his new LA museum
data.description: LOS ANGELES (UNITED STATES) - George Lucas, the legendary creator of the "Star Wars" saga, on Wednesday showcased his long-awaited Museum of Narrative Art, the culmination of nearly two decades of work and numerous obstacles.

data.title: Purin Film Fund opens applications  for sixth edition of Short Film Camp
data.description: <p>The Purin Film Fund is now accepting applications for a 10-day workshop for filmmakers from Myanmar, Thailand, Laos and Cambodia until Sept 25.</p>

data.title: 1,520 electric buses set for rollout
data.description: The Bangkok Mass Transit Authority (BMTA) is preparing 1,520 electric buses to replace ageing vehicles, with deliveries expected to begin in March 2027.

data.title: 151 arrested in e-cigarette blitz
data.description: Cyber police arrested 151 suspects and seized more than 140 million baht over the past year in a crackdown on illegal e-cigarette networks.

data.title: Police seize fake memory cards
data.description: PATHUM THANI: Police have seized 16,245 counterfeit memory cards after complaints that fake products sold online caused severe damage to customers' data and computer systems.

data.title: US Open under the influence: content creators spark debate
data.description: NEW YORK - Jessica Pegula is all in favor of bringing more fans into tennis, but the world number three said Wednesday it's important to keep the focus on the game.

data.title: Sabalenka storms into US Open third round as Pegula, Medvedev advance
data.description: NEW YORK - Aryna Sabalenka took the next step on the road to a rare US Open three-peat, routing qualifier Polina Iatcenko 6-1, 6-1 to join a raft of contenders cruising into the third round on Wednesday.

data.title: Upcycled Pak Klong Talat  materials form 'After Faith'
data.description: <p>Explore the intricate connections between belief, people, objects and society during "After Faith", which is running at Makers' Loft, 3rd floor of Pak Klong Talat, Chakkraphet Road, until Nov 30.</p>

data.title: Nat Studio marks  41st anniversary
data.description: <p>Twenty young pianists will take the stage during "Cream Of Nat Studio &ndash; A Journey Of Growth Through Music", at Sala Sudasiri Sobha, Lat Phrao 41 yaek 7-2, on Sunday at 4pm.</p>

data.title: Lake America? No way, Canadians say
data.description: OTTAWA - For Liam Mooney, Lake Ontario will always be Lake Ontario.

data.title: Tech bosses press G20 to build data centers, but split on risk
data.description: CHAPEL HILL (UNITED STATES) - Top US tech bosses, including Nvidia chief Jensen Huang and OpenAI's Sam Altman, urged G20 ministers Wednesday to embrace artificial intelligence and build the data centers to run it.

data.title: Trump 'happy' Prince Harry and Meghan have left US
data.description: WASHINGTON (UNITED STATES) - President Donald Trump said Wednesday he was glad Prince Harry and his wife Meghan Markle had left the United States -- while adding that if he were part of the British royal family, he would not have taken them back.

data.title: Rare train of Pacific cyclones fueled by historic El Nino
data.description: WASHINGTON (UNITED STATES) - Two powerful hurricanes and a strengthening tropical storm on Wednesday were churning through the Pacific Ocean where waters were being warmed by a historically strong El Nino climate episode.

data.title: EU summons Russia envoys, eyes sanctions after Germany drone 'attack'
data.description: WICKLOW (IRELAND) - EU countries on Wednesday summoned Russia's envoys and discussed fresh sanctions after a drone incident in Germany that the bloc's foreign policy chief said bore the marks of "state-sponsored terrorism".

data.title: BMA targets protection of mature trees
data.description: <p>The Bangkok Metropolitan Administration (BMA) is stepping up efforts to expand and protect the capital's green spaces by introducing a "heritage tree" designation for valuable mature trees.</p>

data.title: Data gap clouds fate of wild bears
data.description: <p>A lack of reliable data on Thailand's wild bears is hampering efforts to track population declines and protect the animals as threats to their survival intensify.</p>

data.title: Big names missing from squad
data.description: <p>The Football Association of Thailand has confirmed its 23‑man squad for the men's football tournament at the 20th Asian Games to be staged in Aichi-Nagoya from Sept 15 to Oct 3.</p>

data.title: Ratchanok cruises, Panitchaphon falls
data.description: <p>Ratchanok Intanon eased through her opening match at the US$1.25 million BWF China Masters in Shenzhen on Wednesday, but fellow Thai Panitchaphon Teeraratsakul suffered an early exit.</p>

data.title: DSI serves summons on PP's Somchart
data.description: <p>The Department of Special Investigation (DSI) has successfully served a summons on People's Party (PP) MP for Phuket Somchart Techathavorncharoen, ordering him to give a statement next Monday in connection with an investigation into suspected nominee arrangements involving property companies in Phuket.</p>

data.title: Fire-damaged site sealed for debris clean-up
data.description: <p>Authorities have declared the area surrounding the fire-damaged Khlong Thom Centre building a restricted fire zone as they move in to dismantle debris.</p>

data.title: Bulbul breeding allowed, trapping banned
data.description: <p>The removal of Thailand's red-whiskered bulbul (nok krong hua juk) from the protected wildlife list does not allow people to trap the birds in the wild, Natural Resources and Environment Minister Suchart Chomklin stressed.</p>

data.title: DSI officers face investigation over exam fraud links
data.description: <p>Justice Minister Pol Lt Gen Rutthapon Naowarat has ordered an investigation into two Department of Special Investigation (DSI) officers allegedly linked to local-government exam fraud, while People's Party MP Rangsiman Rome examines possible wider political involvement.</p>

data.title: Migrant group urges law to protect fishing workers
data.description: <p>The Migrant Working Group (MWG) has submitted a proposed marine fishing labour protection bill to the People's Party (PP), seeking parliamentary action against exploitation and forced labour.</p>

data.title: Court revives NBTC chief's qualification case
data.description: <p>The Supreme Administrative Court has overturned a lower court's refusal to hear a challenge by the chairman of the National Broadcasting and Telecommunications Commission (NBTC) against the NBTC selection committee's ruling on his qualifications.</p>

data.title: Pheu Thai dismisses coalition fears
data.description: <p>Pheu Thai Party (PT) leader Julapun Amornvivat has dismissed concerns over government instability, saying a dinner planned for coalition leaders on Sunday is intended to improve communication and coordinate government work, not prepare for a no-confidence debate.</p>

data.title: Parties agree on initial House targets
data.description: <p>The opposition has named Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul and Digital Economy and Society Minister Chaichanok Chidchob as initial no-confidence targets over concerns about government accountability and policy implementation.</p>

data.title: Low-carbon shift 'a growth engine'
data.description: <p>The low-carbon transition should be treated as a new growth engine for Thailand rather than an environmental obligation, Joint Standing Committee on Commerce, Industry and Banking (JSCCIB) co-chairman Payong Srivanich said on Wednesday.</p>
